title: Hearing on supporting multilingual children in early childhood education
summary: The Council's Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education will examine how the city supports multi-language learners in early childhood programs, hearing from city agencies, educators and advocates. It will also consider a resolution opposing a federal proposal to require English-only instruction in Head Start and to loosen staffing and ratio rules. Advocates note that about 45 percent of New York children ages 0 to 5, roughly 554,000 kids, are multi-language learners.
